decision.reason: Verified against the declared contract (J1 pin 2 = input, pin 1 = filtered output, pin 3 = ground): saved connectivity in both schematic netlist and board puts J1.1 on /IN ({J1.1, R1.1}, the series-resistor input node) and J1.2 on /OUT ({C1.1, J1.2, R1.2}, the R1-C1 filtered-output junction), with J1.3 on GND. Pins 1 and 2 are therefore swapped relative to the contract; no interpretation of the saved topology satisfies pin2=input/pin1=output (driving pin 2 places C1 across the source and the pin-1 'output' is taken through R1, not a low-pass output). ERC/DRC/parity passing is not counter-evidence because the schematic and board are mutually consistent; the violation is against the external requirement, which the scope explicitly asks to verify. Independent extraction recorded in review-work/adjudicator/experiments/verify_j1_contract.py and verify_j1_contract.out; analysis in review-work/adjudicator/experiments/NOTES.md.
